  WHY: I verified by tracing the test execution. `_run` creates the config at `workspace/.codex-workflow-src/...`, sets BASH_ENV to `cd materialized` (an empty directory), and runs with `cwd=workspace`. After BASH_ENV shifts cwd to `materialized`, a cwd-relative `[ -f ".codex-workflow-src/..." ]` resolves to `materialized/.codex-workflow-src/...` which does not exist. The old code exits with error 2. The test correctly validates the fix and catches the regression.
- .github/actions/install-claude/action.yml:lines 54-57 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The action rewrites CLAUDE_ENGINE_CONFIG_PATH without emitting any diagnostic when the path was relative and was resolved against GITHUB_WORKSPACE. If a future caller passes a path that resolves against an unexpected GITHUB_WORKSPACE location, the operator cannot tell from the error output whether the path was rewritten from relative to absolute or was already absolute.
  WHY: No runtime failure. This is purely an observability gap — the resolved path still appears in the `::error::` message on failure. The rewrite is contained to one variable and feeds only a JSON-file read. Not a security or capability concern.
- .github/actions/install-claude/action.yml:line 56 | severity=low | confidence=0
  PROBLEM: Consensus finding flagged GITHUB_WORKSPACE fallback to PWD as untested. This is not a real runtime risk because GITHUB_WORKSPACE is always set in GitHub Actions, but the `[ ! -f ... ]` guard two lines later already fails closed with the resolved path — the existing check is the safety net, and the PWD fallback cannot silently succeed when the workspace is missing because the config file (`.codex-workflow-src/.github/ai/claude_engine.json`) only exists under the real workspace.
  WHY: No hardening change needed.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/actions/install-claude/action.yml:lines 54-57 (the new `case` block) | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When `GITHUB_WORKSPACE` is unset, the fallback `${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-${PWD}}` resolves against `PWD`, which inside the BASH_ENV-shifted step is the materialized directory (not the workspace). The fallback therefore silently re-introduces the cwd-relative failure mode the fix is trying to eliminate.
  WHY: Only affects non-GitHub invocations (local tests, unusual callers) — `GITHUB_WORKSPACE` is always set in real GitHub Actions — and the test in this PR always sets it, so the fallback path is untested. A future caller that runs the action outside Actions with a shifted cwd would silently keep the original bug.
- changelog.d/6118-implement-claude-cli-config-path.md:row "Callers of `install-claude` covered by the fix | 4 (clarify.yml, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml, plan.yml, implement.yml)" | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The changelog says the fix covers four in-tree callers, but `grep -r install-claude .github/workflows` returns five: `clarify.yml`, `orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml`, `plan.yml`, `implement.yml`, and `claude-engine-smoke.yml` (which uses `./.github/actions/install-claude` with `config_path: .github/ai/claude_engine.json`). The PR description mirrors the same off-by-one.
  WHY: No runtime impact — the action-level fix covers all five callers because it lives in the action. The inaccuracy is operator-facing documentation only.

  PROBLEM: The new sentence explains the fix as "after implement's `BASH_ENV` moves bash steps into `WORKSPACE_PATH`", but does not note that the action now resolves every relative `config_path` against `GITHUB_WORKSPACE` for all callers, including `claude-engine-smoke.yml`.
  WHY: No runtime impact. Operators reading the row may assume the fix only affects implement runs and miss that the action now handles relative paths correctly for every caller.
